fields.title: Gakkō Unei oyobi Chōhatsu ni Kansuru Gyōsei Hōkoku (Administrative Report on School Operation and Requisition)

report.subject: Investigation and execution of school building reallocation for military logistics under occupation directives
report.author: Yamamoto Kenzo (Chōkan Somuka Buchō)

fields.summary: Gunseibu no meirei ni motoduki, kyōiku shisetsu no gunji riyō ni kansuru chōsa oyobi chōhatsu no kōka o kiroku suru.
findings: Kokumin gakkō no kyōshitsu wa gunji yusōbutsu no hokan basho oyobi kunren shisetsu to shite saihaichi sareta.
Kyōshi Siti Aminah wa shitei sareta daitai katsudō basho e no ninmu idō o yōkyū sarete iru.
recommendations: Kyōin no daitai ninmu o zikkō shi, gunji kyōiku keikaku ni kyōryoku saseru.
Kankei shisetsu no kanri o gunseibu no kantoku ka ni oku.

claims.fact: Laporan administratif mengonfirmasi realokasi bangunan sekolah untuk kebutuhan logistik militer di bawah pemerintahan pendudukan.
